Berkeley Roof Replacement

Professional Roofing Services in Berkeley, CA
When your roof begins showing signs of age, leaking, damaged shingles, deteriorated flashing, or worn waterproofing, choosing an experienced Berkeley roofing contractor is one of the most important decisions you can make for your property.

Roof Express provides professional roof replacement in Berkeley, California, for homeowners and property owners looking for a durable, attractive, and properly waterproofed roofing system.

From traditional asphalt shingle roofs to flat and low-slope roofing systems, our team can evaluate the existing roof, identify problem areas, recommend the appropriate roofing system, and complete the installation using quality materials and proven roofing methods.

We proudly serve homeowners throughout Berkeley, North Berkeley, South Berkeley, West Berkeley, Elmwood, Claremont, Thousand Oaks, the Berkeley Hills, and surrounding East Bay communities.

Whether your property needs a complete reroof, a flat roof replacement, new shingles, skylight replacement, gutters, or roof repairs, Roof Express is ready to help.
Does Your Berkeley Home Need a New Roof?
Not every roofing problem means that the entire roof needs to be replaced. In some cases, a professional roof repair or maintenance service may be enough.

However, homeowners should consider a complete roof replacement in Berkeley when the existing roofing system is reaching the end of its service life or has widespread deterioration.

Common signs that it may be time for a new roof include:

Missing, cracked, curling, or deteriorated shingles

Repeated roof leaks

Water stains on ceilings or walls

Soft or damaged roof decking

Deteriorated flashing around chimneys, walls, skylights, pipes, and vents

Blistering or cracking on a flat roof

Ponding water on low-slope roofing areas

Multiple previous roof repairs

Loose or damaged roofing materials

Visible daylight or moisture entering the attic

An aging roof that requires increasingly frequent maintenance

A professional roof inspection can help determine whether repair, maintenance, or complete replacement is the most appropriate option.
Complete Berkeley Roof Replacement Services
At Roof Express, our goal is to provide a complete roofing system rather than simply covering an existing problem.

A typical Berkeley reroofing project may include removal of the existing roofing materials, inspection of the roof deck, replacement of damaged decking when necessary, installation of waterproofing and underlayment, new roofing materials, flashing, penetrations, and final cleanup.

The exact scope depends on the roof design and existing conditions.
1. Roof Preparation and Property Protection
Before beginning the roof replacement, our crew prepares the property and work areas.

We take appropriate precautions around the home, landscaping, walkways, driveways, and surrounding areas while establishing safe access to the roof.

Materials and equipment are organized before tear-off begins to help keep the project moving efficiently.
2. Removal of Existing Roofing
The existing roof covering is removed as required to expose the underlying roof deck.

Removing deteriorated materials allows our roofing professionals to inspect areas that are normally hidden beneath the finished roofing system.

Old roofing materials and construction debris are collected and properly removed from the property.
3. Roof Deck Inspection
Once the existing roofing has been removed, we inspect the exposed roof decking.

The roof deck provides the structural surface beneath the roofing system, so damaged or deteriorated sections should be addressed before new roofing materials are installed.

If damaged plywood or other concealed conditions are discovered, we discuss the recommended repairs before proceeding with additional work.
4. Waterproofing and Underlayment
A roof is more than the visible shingles or cap sheet.

Proper waterproofing beneath the finished roof is an important part of protecting the structure against water intrusion.

Depending on the roofing system, waterproofing materials may be installed around vulnerable areas such as:

Roof edges

Valleys

Skylights

Pipes

Plumbing vents

Roof-to-wall transitions

Chimneys

Other roof penetrations

The remaining roof area receives the appropriate underlayment or roofing base system based on the selected roofing material.
5. New Roofing Installation
Once preparation and waterproofing are complete, our roofing team installs the selected roofing system according to the project specifications and applicable manufacturer installation requirements.

We work with roofing systems including:

Asphalt composition shingles

CertainTeed roofing systems

Architectural shingles

Cool-roof shingle options

Modified bitumen roofing

Torch-down roofing

Flat roofing systems

Low-slope roofing systems

Our goal is to provide a clean, properly detailed roofing installation designed for long-term weather protection.
Asphalt Shingle Roof Replacement in Berkeley
Asphalt shingles remain one of the most popular roofing choices for Berkeley homes because they offer an attractive combination of durability, appearance, and value.

Roof Express installs professional asphalt shingle roofing systems, including CertainTeed Landmark® and Landmark® PRO products where appropriate for the project.

A complete shingle roofing system can include:

New asphalt shingles

Synthetic roof underlayment

Waterproofing at critical areas

Starter shingles

Hip and ridge shingles

New flashing as required

Pipe and vent flashing

Roof ventilation components

Drip edge and perimeter details

Homeowners can choose from a variety of shingle colors and profiles to complement the architectural style of their Berkeley property.
Flat Roof Replacement in Berkeley, CA
Berkeley contains many homes, additions, garages, apartment buildings, and commercial properties with flat or low-slope roofs.

These roofs require roofing materials designed specifically for low-slope applications.

Roof Express provides flat roof replacement in Berkeley using modified bitumen roofing systems when appropriate.

Depending on the project, the roofing assembly may include multiple layers designed to provide waterproofing and long-term protection.

Proper detailing is especially important around:

Drains

Scuppers

Skylights

Plumbing penetrations

Walls

Parapets

Roof edges

Roof-to-wall transitions

If your Berkeley flat roof is cracking, leaking, blistering, separating at seams, or repeatedly requiring repairs, our team can inspect the roof and determine whether maintenance, repair, or full replacement is recommended.
Modified Bitumen and Torch-Down Roofing
Modified bitumen roofing is commonly used on flat and low-slope roofs throughout the Bay Area.

Roof Express installs modified bitumen roofing systems, including multi-layer torch-applied systems where appropriate.

A properly installed modified bitumen roofing system provides a continuous waterproof surface and is particularly useful for low-slope areas where traditional shingles should not be installed.

The number of layers and specific materials used depends on the project requirements, roof conditions, manufacturer specifications, and selected roofing assembly.
Skylight Replacement During a Berkeley Reroof
Roof replacement is also an excellent opportunity to evaluate existing skylights.

Older skylights can become a common source of leaks when their flashing, seals, curbs, or glazing systems deteriorate.

Roof Express can coordinate skylight replacement in Berkeley as part of a roofing project.

Our skylight services may include:

Existing skylight removal

Fixed skylight replacement

Operable skylight replacement

Custom skylight replacement

Curb-mounted skylights

Skylight flashing

Waterproofing around skylight openings

When custom skylights are required, our team can field-measure the existing opening and coordinate fabrication of a replacement designed for the existing conditions.
Gutter and Downspout Replacement
A roofing system works together with gutters and downspouts to move rainwater away from the building.

Damaged, improperly aligned, leaking, or deteriorated gutters can allow water to collect near fascia boards, walls, foundations, and other areas of the home.

Roof Express can provide gutter-related work in conjunction with a Berkeley roof replacement, including:

Gutter replacement

Downspout replacement

Gutter alignment

Gutter repairs

Gutter cleaning

Gutter screen replacement

If your gutters are aging along with the roof, replacing both systems during the same project may provide a cleaner finished appearance.
Roof Ventilation and Roof Penetrations
Pipes, exhaust vents, roof vents, and other penetrations are common areas where roofing leaks can develop.

During reroofing, these areas must be properly integrated into the new roofing system.

Depending on existing conditions, Roof Express can replace or waterproof roof penetrations and flashing to create a complete roofing assembly.

Attention to these details is important because even an excellent roofing material can develop leaks when penetrations are improperly flashed.
Roofing Berkeley's Unique Homes
Berkeley has a wide range of residential architecture, from older homes and Craftsman-style properties to contemporary homes, multi-unit buildings, additions, and properties with combinations of pitched and flat roofing.

These roof designs may include:

Steep pitched roofs

Low-slope roofs

Flat roof additions

Roof-to-wall transitions

Multiple roof levels

Skylights

Valleys

Chimneys

Parapet walls

Complex drainage areas

Because every property is different, we recommend inspecting the existing roof before preparing the final roofing scope.

This allows Roof Express to recommend a system appropriate for the specific roof rather than applying the same solution to every property.
Roofing Permits in Berkeley
Depending on the scope of the roofing project, building permits and inspections may be required.

Roof Express can help coordinate the roofing permit and required inspection process when included in the project scope.

Permit requirements and fees can vary depending on the property and project, so they should be confirmed for the specific job before construction begins.

Our team works to keep the roofing process organized from initial inspection through installation and final inspection.
What Happens During a Berkeley Roof Replacement?
Homeowners often ask what they should expect when replacing a roof.

Although every project is different, the general process typically includes:
Initial Roof Inspection
We inspect the roofing materials, flashing, penetrations, drainage areas, and visible roof conditions.
Roofing Proposal
After the inspection, Roof Express prepares a detailed estimate describing the recommended roofing work.
Material Selection
The homeowner selects the roofing system and applicable material or shingle color.
Project Scheduling
Once the proposal is approved, we coordinate materials, crew availability, and the project start date.
Tear-Off
The existing roofing is removed according to the agreed scope.
Deck Inspection
The roof deck is inspected for concealed damage.
Waterproofing
Underlayment and waterproofing materials are installed.
New Roofing Installation
The selected roofing system is professionally installed.
Flashing and Roof Details
Skylights, vents, pipes, walls, valleys, edges, and other details are completed.
Cleanup
Roofing debris and construction materials are removed from the property.
Final Inspection
The completed roofing system is reviewed and applicable municipal inspections are coordinated when required.
Why Berkeley Homeowners Choose Roof Express
Choosing the right roofing company in Berkeley involves more than comparing the lowest price.

A roof is one of the primary systems protecting your property, and installation quality can make a significant difference in long-term performance.

Roof Express focuses on professional roofing installation, detailed project scopes, quality materials, communication, and proper waterproofing.

Homeowners choose Roof Express for:

Experienced roofing professionals

Complete roof replacement services

Asphalt shingle roofing

Flat and low-slope roofing

Modified bitumen roofing

Skylight replacement

Gutters and downspouts

Roof repairs and maintenance

Detailed roof inspections

Quality roofing materials

Professional project management

Bay Area roofing experience

Roof Repair or Complete Roof Replacement?
One of the most common questions homeowners ask is whether they should repair or replace their roof.

A repair may make sense when the roofing system is generally in good condition and the problem is isolated.

For example, a localized leak around a penetration or a small damaged section may be repairable.

Complete roof replacement may be more appropriate when:

The roof has widespread deterioration

Several areas are leaking

Roofing materials are reaching the end of their expected life

Large portions of the roof have already been repaired

The waterproofing system has deteriorated

The homeowner wants a complete long-term roofing solution

Roof Express can inspect the roof and explain the available options so the property owner can make an informed decision.
Roof Maintenance in Berkeley
Even a roof that does not require replacement should be inspected periodically.

Routine maintenance can help identify small issues before they turn into more expensive leaks.

Common maintenance items include:

Inspecting roof penetrations

Resealing vulnerable flashing areas

Checking skylights

Checking roof drains

Clearing debris

Inspecting gutters

Checking shingles for damage

Examining flat roof seams

Inspecting roof-to-wall transitions

Berkeley homeowners with mature trees near their property may especially benefit from periodic roof and gutter inspection because leaves and debris can accumulate around drainage areas.
How Much Does Roof Replacement Cost in Berkeley?
The cost of a roof replacement in Berkeley, CA varies based on the specific property and project.

Important pricing factors include:

Total roof area

Roof pitch

Number of roofing layers being removed

Roofing material selected

Flat versus pitched roof construction

Accessibility

Roof height

Skylights

Chimneys and penetrations

Flashing requirements

Roof deck condition

Drainage modifications

Gutters and downspouts

Permit requirements

Custom roofing details

Because roofing conditions vary significantly between properties, the best way to determine the cost is through an on-site roof inspection and written estimate.
Areas We Serve Around Berkeley
Roof Express provides roofing services throughout Berkeley and surrounding East Bay communities.

Our Berkeley service areas include:

Downtown Berkeley

North Berkeley

Elmwood

Berkeley Hills

Northbrae

We also serve homeowners and property owners throughout the greater San Francisco Bay Area.
Frequently Asked Questions About Berkeley Roof ReplacementHow do I know whether I need a new roof?
Frequent leaks, deteriorated roofing materials, damaged decking, extensive previous repairs, and widespread roof deterioration can indicate that replacement should be considered. A professional roof inspection is the best way to determine the condition of your roof.
Do you replace both shingle and flat roofs?
Yes. Roof Express works with pitched asphalt shingle roofs as well as flat and low-slope modified bitumen roofing systems.
Can you replace skylights while replacing the roof?
Yes. Skylight replacement can be coordinated with a roof replacement project. Standard and custom skylight options may be available depending on the existing opening and roof design.
Can you replace damaged plywood?
Yes. After removing the existing roofing, the roof deck can be inspected. Damaged or deteriorated decking can be replaced as needed according to the approved project scope or change order.
Can you replace gutters with the roof?
Yes. Roof Express can provide gutter and downspout replacement as part of a roofing project.
Do you provide roof inspections in Berkeley?
Yes. Roof Express provides roof inspections to evaluate existing roofing conditions and determine whether maintenance, repair, or replacement should be considered.
Do Berkeley roofing projects require permits?
Permit requirements depend on the scope and property. When a permit is required for the project, the process should be coordinated with the City of Berkeley before and during construction as applicable.
What type of roofing is best for a Berkeley home?
The appropriate roofing material depends on the slope, existing structure, drainage, architectural design, budget, and homeowner preferences. Asphalt shingles are commonly used on pitched roofs, while modified bitumen systems are suitable for many flat and low-slope roofs.
Get a Berkeley Roof Replacement Estimate
If your roof is leaking, deteriorating, or approaching the point where replacement makes more sense than continued repairs, contact Roof Express for a professional roofing evaluation.
